name: Hazezon, Shaper of Sand
oracle_text:
Desertwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Desert.)
You may play Desert lands from your graveyard.
Whenever a Desert you control enters, create two 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature tokens.
blocked_sentences: Desertwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Desert.)

needs.what: a landwalk keyword for the nonbasic land type Desert (702.14): the creature can't be blocked while the defending player controls a Desert -- a sixth row in LANDWALK_SUBTYPE (desertwalk -> Desert) plus the Keyword enum entry
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The keyword list carries only the five basic landwalks and nonbasic_landwalk; combat.can_block reads landwalk from LANDWALK_SUBTYPE against the defending player. A block_restriction static's `blockers` filter reads only the blocker's qualities, and a static `exists` condition can only ask whether any opponent controls a Desert, not the defending player, so it would wrongly make the creature unblockable against every opponent in multiplayer
